review.intent_summary: Provide inspectable fixed-fit forecasts from complete observations while preserving calendar positions, causal historical evidence, policy diagnostics and explicit limitations.

criteria.criterion: Complete zeros and signed measurements remain observations; partial tails preserve time and missing periods return unavailable without filling or compression.

Forecasts use observations only, retain horizon prefixes and adjust only future learned trend changes; explicit recent-level-v1 compares smoothing against persistence on bounded chronological multi-step holdouts and retains persistence without supported improvement, independently of outlier policy.

Historical expectations and matching residual calibration use frozen prefix model and baseline selection; later observations cannot change earlier targets, with original indices and honest warmup and maturity preserved.

Results expose original indices, fit and inference windows, outlier policy effects that distinguish forward screening from historical reference adjustments, and separate forecast applicability from anomaly maturity without confidence claims.
Validated calendar inputs honor local calendar boundaries including DST and variable months; invalid, budget and numerical failures never return a completed partial forecast.
criteria.notes: Generated dates are not checked for nonexistent local midnight boundaries. Eight valid daily buckets ending 2018-11-03 in America/Sao_Paulo return completed with 2018-11-04T00:00:00-03:00, which resolves to 01:00 locally and is rejected by the input validator. Validate generated boundaries and return unavailable atomically.

verification_evidence: .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_forecast.py tests/test_recent_level.py -k "frozen_selection or constant_ties or selection_is_chronological or horizon_prefix or contaminate or historical_reference or calendar or month or dst or budget_and_numerical or json_models or runtime_size" — 38 passed, 53 deselected.
Manual runtime reproduction confirmed the nonexistent-midnight forecast timestamp and its rejection when supplied back as input.

Inspected every implementation reference and traced historical selection, residual rebuilding and evidence projection; checked evaluation windows, disclosed policy regressions, privacy limits and comparison-default guidance.
remaining_gaps: Reject nonexistent generated calendar boundaries before returning completed, with a regression covering midnight DST transitions.
Representative reconciled production histories and reviewed outcomes remain necessary before changing UsageTap's comparison default.
Supported-Python and offline Linux Lambda release-artifact checks were not established by this source review.
